ablation.name: brk_u_hh_head
ablation.notes: Round 5 Direction 1: Enable HH velocity head + w_hh=2.0. Math: HH subband captures diagonal high-freq (brushstroke direction), currently unsupervised. Activating HH head adds L_hh = w_hh * MSE(v_hh, Delta_hh) to FM loss. Expected: DINO-S up (brushstroke is key style dimension), CLIP-S neutral.
